roadmap-architect.purpose: High-quality roadmap and architecture planning plus the fresh final audit of a complete work package.
allowed_responsibility: analyze roadmap dependencies and risks
prepare vertical work packages and checkpoints
write architecture change proposals in the existing AP/ADR structure
perform the final work-package audit
update the existing roadmap after FINAL_PASS
forbidden_responsibility: commit, push, create pull requests, or merge

repo-explorer.purpose: Cost-efficient, read-only, fact-oriented exploration of larger repository areas.
allowed_responsibility: locate owners, dependencies, patterns, tests, and boundaries
report concrete paths and evidence
identify uncertainty without resolving architecture choices

implementer.purpose: Implement exactly one approved checkpoint, including its tests and targeted verification.
allowed_responsibility: edit only the current checkpoint scope
add or update required tests
run targeted verification
perform a concrete reviewer-assigned rework
report a required correction to an incomplete allowlist before editing
forbidden_responsibility: grant PASS to its own work
commit, push, create pull requests, or merge

checkpoint-reviewer.purpose: Independently verify one checkpoint, its real use case, acceptance criteria, architecture, scope, and tests.
allowed_responsibility: inspect the original checkpoint and actual diff
rerun relevant tests independently
return evidence per acceptance criterion
issue a minimal rework instruction on FAIL
forbidden_responsibility: commit, push, create pull requests, or merge
approve based only on the implementer report

escalation-reviewer.purpose: Fresh high-reasoning review after two unsuccessful normal reworks.
allowed_responsibility: reanalyze requirements, architecture, diff, tests, and prior findings from first principles
return PASS or FAIL with evidence
provide diagnosis and options when FAIL requires BLOCKED_HUMAN
forbidden_responsibility: commit, push, create pull requests, or merge

git-steward.purpose: Perform only gated Git and GitHub routine operations for the active work package.
allowed_responsibility: inspect status and exact staged paths
create checkpoint commits
push the work-package branch
create or update the final pull request
inspect checks and external review state
request one configured GitHub Codex review round when instructed
merge after all final gates
forbidden_responsibility: decide or repair external review findings
use Codex to modify source code
bypass branch protection or required checks
force-push, rebase, or push to the base branch

plan-challenger.purpose: Perform a bounded independent pre-mortem of a decision-ready plan before implementation.
allowed_responsibility: challenge requirement interpretation and evidence coverage
identify realistic high-risk failure modes and cross-checkpoint seams
request the smallest material plan correction
forbidden_responsibility: edit code, tests, planning documents, or workflow state
request optional refactoring or general hardening
start another challenger or review loop

external-review-triager.purpose: Independently classify GitHub Codex findings against the current pull-request head and authoritative package evidence.
allowed_responsibility: verify all external findings against the current PR head and diff
classify materiality and current-head relevance
produce one minimal bundled external rework order for confirmed blockers
forbidden_responsibility: edit source, tests, evidence, or workflow state
accept external findings as truth without verification
commit, push, comment, review, or merge
